acceptance_rules: Require all12 ordered case identities, actual completion, unmodified fixture/reference/source pins and valid runner cleanup.

The removal case permits only the two exact optional post-removal author-recording rows listed, each at most once after before-remove. It permits no iframe-element-load or pageshow after removal. This does not assert that Chromium aborted running JavaScript.

observed_state_contract.pending: A newly created document or document.open after Complete starts a new cycle.
observed_state_contract.in_progress: Begins before native Window load dispatch and lasts through owner element load and pageshow. Same active Document open preserves this phase, allowing replacement readiness but no recursive lifecycle.
observed_state_contract.complete: After the cycle returns, later document.open may start a new cycle.
observed_state_contract.preflight_guard: Separate guard before frame scan, host sync and readiness callbacks prevents nested same-generation completion. Parser-generation changes abort stale pre-event work only; they do not cancel the active same-Document continuation.
observed_state_contract.live_context: After every callback, relookup saved context ID before dereferencing saved context, then require same active Document/Window and connected owner. A requested srcdoc navigation is not a committed replacement.
